candidate.answerReason: Multiplication comes first: 3×(-4)=-12, and 2+(-12)=-10, which is choice D.

methods.label: Multiply before adding
methods.explanation: First perform the multiplication \(3\times(-4)=-12\), then calculate \(2+(-12)=-10\). Performing the addition first would give \(-20\).
